cases.requirementText: The system shall maintain a comprehensive record of qualifying expenditures across multiple years, enabling users to tag fixed assets as qualifying expenditure ("QE") or non-qualifying expenditure and capture the corresponding eligible amounts. Users will have the capability to assign and manage Initial Allowance (IA) and Annual Allowance (AA) rates for each qualifying expenditure, ensuring accurate capital allowance computation for tax purposes.

cases.requirementText:
Deferred Tax: 
(a) Automatically identify and measure deferred tax arising from temporary differences (e.g. differences between fixed asset accounting net book value and tax written-down value).

(b) Generate automated deferred tax journals with full audit trails.

(c) Allow controlled manual adjustments for off-ledger items such as unutilised business losses or tax credits, subject to justification, approval workflow, and full auditability.

(d) For deferred tax assets, allow users to determine whether to recognise the asset (in full or in part) based on recoverability, with appropriate justification, approval workflow, and audit trail.
cases.expectedScopeItemNames: Tax depreciation area + deferred tax computation

cases.requirementText:
Tax Payment Tracking: 
(a) Maintain separate tracking for CP 204/ CP 204A tax instalment) by legal entity and year of assessment.
(b) Allow users to set up and maintain the approved instalment schedule (monthly amount, start/end month) based on initial/ revised estimates.
(c) Provide alerts/reminders for tax instalment payments.
(d) Allow users to manually input the final tax payable once the tax computation is finalised. Automatically compute total tax instalments against the final tax payable to derive the remaining tax payable or tax refundable position.
(e) Support reconciliation between instalments paid, final tax payable, and balance sheet tax payable/refundable at year end.
cases.expectedScopeItemNames: Compliance with Local Requirements (MY) + custom CP 204 instalment tracking

cases.requirementText: Mandatory/Optional Fields: Able to allow specified fields in the master data to be made mandatory (e.g., IC number) or optional entry.

cases.requirementText: The Vendor MUST have a minimum of RM2,000,000 shareholders’ funds in the most recent financial year. Otherwise, the vendor MUST obtain a letter of undertaking from their holding/sister companies which has fulfilled the positive shareholders’ funds requirement or provide a bank guarantee that is mutually agreed by both parties.

Termination for convenience:
 
Bursa Malaysia is able to provide a sixty (60) day advance written notice to the vendor to terminate the contract with the vendor without cause. The vendor, on the other hand, remains committed throughout the term of the contract and does not demand similar termination rights.

Assesses the vendor’s overall proven experience in delivering ERP SaaS implementation projects of similar scale and complexity. Evaluates the number of years the vendor has consistently delivered enterprise‑level ERP SaaS implementations.

The vendor must provide the proper technical documentation that covers the following areas:
   i.)  Design Considerations/ Technical Requirement
    ii) Technical Architecture consist of architecture diagram, infrastructure diagram, detail/low-level design, technology/software stack, security
   iii) System Interfaces
    iv) Backup Mechanism
   v) System monitoring
   vi) Hardware specifications

Support Structure:

a)  vendor shall be able to provide at least of 9 x 5 support. Refer to Support Hours tab for the details of support hours required

Exit Management:
The exit management strategy includes Bursa Malaysia’s right to either retain (or take possession of) the solution together with the requisite rights to use, modify and maintain the solution, or to reject all or part of the solution

Assesses the vendor’s track record in implementing ERP SaaS Core Financials & Procurement modules.  Evaluates the number of comparable Core Financials projects successfully delivered in the last five (5) years.
